messages:
Aisha (Support): Escalation: PulseLane trial tenant pl-trial-9 reporting embed timeouts during bulk ingest. They're running sales demos tomorrow and asked for a fix ASAP. @Omar can CS take point? :bangbang:
Omar (CSM): On it. Aisha, paste the console alert and any SDK flags they changed.
Aisha (Support): Snippet:
```
2026-04-10T08:12:03Z ERROR embed-service tenant=pl-trial-9 rate=750/s limit=450/s quota_exceeded
2026-04-10T08:12:05Z ERROR client sdk timeout request_id=xyz789
```
Aisha (Support): They said they increased "parallel_uploads" to 8 yesterday.
Nina (CS): Risk: stalled activation -> missed demos -> renewal signal. Comms plan: 1) immediate ACK + ETA, 2) 30m triage with eng within 4h, 3) temp throughput uplift + smoothing, 4) enablement on batching, 5) file SDK default feedback. Omar, want to own external note?
Omar (CSM): Yes. I'll send the short acknowledgement and schedule the triage. Keep external message non-technical.
Evan (Engineer): Likely their concurrency spiked tenant burst credit; embed fleet in us-west-2 at high utilization. Short-term: bump soft limit to 900/s for 12-24h and enable smoothing; long-term: batching, SDK defaults, and autoscale. I'll join the call.
ops-bot: [meeting] Created incident-pl-1766614321 meeting at 2026-04-10T09:30:00Z; attendees: Omar, Evan, Aisha, Nina
Omar (CSM): Draft customer note:
"Hi PulseLane team  thanks for flagging. We're investigating throttling during your recent ingest that is affecting demos. We've scheduled a troubleshooting call with engineers and will temporarily increase throughput while we stabilize. We'll also offer a short enablement on batching best practices. Meeting invite coming.  Omar, CSM"
Nina (CS): Add offer to monitor the demo window and provide a short checklist.
Evan (Engineer): I'll prepare the uplift command and monitoring dashboard; will only execute after verbal ack on the call. Rollback after 24h unless a longer commit is agreed.
Omar (CSM): Action items: Omar send ack (done), Evan prepare uplift, Aisha gather SDK change details, Nina prep AE/RevOps note if >24h.
Aisha (Support): Customer replied: "Thanks, we'll join the call. Please uplift if possible for our demo"
Nina (CS): I'll flag renewal-watch at 24h if unresolved and update account health sentiment.
Omar (CSM): Post-call I'll attach notes and the enablement recording to the account, and file product feedback about SDK defaults.
Aisha (Support): -- end thread --
